defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.description: The Phase 1 registry regression test incorrectly required the public experiment registry to remain permanently empty after validated R3.2 evidence was intentionally published.
defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.repair: The invariant now requires every public experiment entry to carry a validated status while preserving the private-public boundary rule.

defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.description: The replacement registry test initially failed to recognize YAML list entries prefixed with '- '.
defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.repair: The parser now removes the list prefix before matching experiment_id entries.

defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.description: The strengthened all-query replay assertion initially failed the repository Ruff format check.
defects_caught_and_repaired_before_closu.repair: Applied the exact formatter-prescribed layout without weakening or changing the replay criterion.

non_blocking_warnings: The current FastAPI/Starlette TestClient stack emits a deprecation warning that httpx-backed starlette.testclient usage is deprecated in favor of a future test-client dependency. The locked stack passes all tests; this is a dependency-maintenance item, not an R3.3 functional failure.
GitHub Actions reports Node 20 deprecation compatibility warnings for upstream actions that are currently forced to Node 24. These do not affect the R3.3 application result.
boundaries: The search corpus remains fictional and frozen at the Phase 3 evaluation date 2026-08-19.
R3.3 integrates retrieval only; it does not implement generation, answerability policy, routing integration, authentication, rate limiting, or production observability.
Untrusted-content fixtures are returned as evidence data by search and must not be interpreted as executable instructions by later assistance components.
The R3.2 CPU latency evidence is benchmark-environment evidence and is not relabeled as HTTP production latency.
